overview.description: The KraneShares Photonic and Optical ETF (LUMA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund actively manages a global portfolio of companies belonging to the photonics and optical ecosystem, which includes companies involved in the development, manufacturing, and sale of photonics or optical products. LUMA was launched on Jul 15, 2026 and is issued by KraneShares.
